messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: NebulaOps dedicated pool go-live is T+7 days, Thu 09:00 UTC. Need final quota numbers, autoscale profile, and a short load sweep. Who can own traffic scripts?

jake_ops: I can take quota + infra sizing. Quick question: initial autoscale strategy? suggest step-based for first 48h with conservative cooldowns.

rina_eng: Agree on step-based. Also want a 5m KV prime before ramp to avoid cold-token spikes. Ask customer for common prompt prefixes so we can pre-cache.

maria_cs: rina, can you draft priming script? jake, post a step plan. I'll collect customer traffic heatmap today.

jake_ops: Draft autoscale (v0): 
```\n{"reserved_rps":250, "steps":[{"add":150,"cooldown":"3m","sustain":"10m"},{"add":300,"cooldown":"6m","sustain":"20m"}], "burst_pct":15, "headroom_target_pct":30}\n```
I'll convert to infra config.

devon_sre: I'll wire temporary alerts for P95/P99, GPU mem pressure, and request queue depth. Also add a paged policy if P99 > 1200ms for 5m.
maria_cs: Customer: please confirm spike durations + sample payloads. jake, can we do a Wed preflight 30m run at 08:30 UTC?

jake_ops: Wed 08:30 OK. I'll spin a shadow pool for smoke. Plan: 5m KV prime, 10m at 50% planned load, then ramp to 100% for 15m.

rina_eng: k6 example to run load sweep: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 20m nebula-sweep.js`  include a small set of long-context prompts to hit KV misses.

maria_cs: Risk note: if latency degrades >10% first week, flag renewal risk and run fallback. I'll annotate the ticket with mitigation steps.

devon_sre: Rollback plan (draft): 1) shift 30% traffic to hosted for 20m, 2) drop to fallback model variant, 3) scale down pool and re-evaluate. I'll write runbook bullets.

support-bot: Scheduled: smoke-pool spin-up 2026-04-15T08:15:00Z (job: smoke-1765436789).

jake_ops: I'll push autoscale JSON to infra repo and paste link here after.

rina_eng: Uploading priming script + preflight checklist before Wed.

maria_cs: Thanks all. We'll do final sign-off after Wed preflight. :thumbsup:
